wave.title: acopy: owned pass-through copy

wave.title: dcshift: DC offset with optional limiter
wave.scope:
Options shift [-1,1] and limitergain [0,1], positional (shift:limitergain) or named. Plain decimal literals only; refuse expressions and suffixes, as volume does. Pinned format 's32p'.
- Without the limiter: d = shift*(INT32_MAX+1.) + x.
- With limitergain > 0: limiterthreshold = INT32_MAX*(1-(|shift|-limitergain)), then the three native branches. Native adds the raw, unscaled shift in both limiter branches, and the else branch uses shift*INT32_MAX; mirror both.
- Then truncate to int64 and clip to int32 (av_clipl_int32).
- Stateless apply; allocatesFrames=true, other flags false, frameReservation.
- Out-of-range values are refused (native fails too), as are enable and commands.
wave.testStrategy:

- Sources: u8/s16/s32 including INT_MIN/INT_MAX extremes, and f32/f64 with |x| <= 1.1 (-cpuflags 0).

wave.title: aecho: multi-tap echo with tail
wave.scope:
Options in_gain and out_gain (float [0,1]), delays and decays ('|' lists read as float, with native count and validation rules: delay in (0,90000] ms, decay in (0,1]). Refuse commands.
- Native set {s16p,s32p,fltp,dblp}. Custom negotiate: u8->s16p, s16->s16p, s32->s32p, flt->fltp, dbl->dblp.

- After EOF, emit max_samples of tail fed with silence, in chunks of up to 2048. Declare generatesOutput=true, reframes=true and count() packets trailing {samples:max_samples, span:2048}.
- Declare the per-channel delay ring in reserve() and refuse it beyond the budget.

dependencies: The container format registry must exist on prep/registries before any of the 10 media agents start. Each format needs one module and one registration line covering: magic probe with fixed precedence, the -f name, extension-based input detection, output extensions, default output codec, output validation before creation, mux, header scratch bytes for the memory plan, and a per-format input packet span (AIFF's 4096/blockAlign special case belongs there too). Without it, every media branch edits the same lines in packages/avformat/src/index.ts and packages/containers/src/detect.ts; the pilot merges already conflicted on one long line in index.ts.

Two video changes must also land before the 14 video agents start. packages/avfilter/src/video-ops/registry.ts needs one import and one array entry per line, each ending with a comma. tests/unit/video-operator-registry.test.ts must be driven by the registrations: order-insensitive name comparison, and matrix/descriptions with one entry per line or held on the descriptors. Its unflagged('linear'/'graph'/'stream'/'actor'/'timed') expectations must be derived from the legacy operators only. Without this, every video branch edits the same two lines of the test.
demuxer.sds (order 32) needs the per-format input packet span hook (60/40/30 samples). If prep does not provide it, swap sds for the vidc or sol backfill.
demuxer.rso autodetection needs an extension-based input detection hook. Without it the scope is -f rso only, with explicit failure for undeclared .rso input.
The md5/hash/crc/streamhash muxers need output-only descriptors. Supporting -hash needs a per-format output-option hook; without it -hash is refused.

There are no dependencies between candidates. The four vf_neighbor filters are self-contained, there is no shared colour parser (pad is excluded), and ff_get_line and ff_get_pcm_codec_id are ported privately by each of avr, pvf and nistsphere. Nobody touches the PcmCodec union, avcodec/src/index.ts, containers/src/framecrc.ts, avformat/src/raw-video.ts or the audio descriptor/chain contract.

The float-sensitive audio filters (orders 27 and 33-40) rely on the sandbox reference being an x86_64 build without FMA: default -march, --disable-x86asm, no -ffast-math. Each branch records `cc --version` and the ffmpeg sha256 of its sandbox build. If the sandbox compiler is not GCC on x86_64 baseline, flag it.

waveRules: Before launch, prep/registries adds .gitattributes `merge=union` for packages/avfilter/src/audio/registry.ts, packages/avfilter/src/video-ops/registry.ts, the container registry file, packages/containers/src/index.ts and (if prep keeps per-test tables) tests/unit/video-operator-registry.test.ts. These are all one-entry-per-line files.

Every branch is cut from the same prep/registries commit and named wave1/<slug>. It holds one capability, contains no merges from other wave branches, and is squashed to one commit ending with the required Co-Authored-By trailer.

A branch may touch only its declared ownedFiles plus its declared one-line registry edits. The coordinator checks `git diff --name-only prep/registries...wave1/<slug>` against that list and sends back any branch with extra paths.

Differential tests never pin the macOS sha 1b86106f and never compare against committed macOS digests.
- Read .build/reference/build-metadata.json and assert commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm.
- Integer and copy-only cases run on any platform.
- Float-sensitive cases (asoftclip alg; extrastereo, stereowiden, haas, crystalizer, compensationdelay, adynamicsmooth, aecho; afade non-default silence/unity) run only when platform is linux and arch is x64. Otherwise use it.skipIf with an explicit reason, unless a fused profile is implemented and verified on darwin.

Sandbox setup:
- Use Node 24+, as docs/contributing/environment-setup.md requires. Install it if the image has Node 22, or report that it was not possible.
- Build the reference with `npm run bootstrap -- --only npm,submodule,reference --allow-unpinned-reference`. The sandbox GCC may not reproduce the pinned Linux sha 5e43da9a.
- Use per-test mkdtemp directories, never a shared scratch path. The pilot saw agents clobber each other's files in a shared scratchpad.

Audio rules:
- Keep rateConversion, timeSelection and formatConstraint false.
- Never use output -ar/-ac in matrices; declare rate and channels only on raw input.
- Use -cpuflags 0 whenever float is converted to integer.
- No commas inside filter arguments.
- Refuse in constraint() any input that native would silently resample or remix.
- Declare every ring or history in reserve().
- The untimed FLAC path always runs the chain. It cannot be tested in the sandbox, so do not add FLAC integration or workers tests; document the path as unverified.

Video rules:
- Refuse enable= and runtime commands.
- Flag all five paths only when actor and timed differential tests pass. Otherwise flag linear/graph/stream and add rejection tests; prep's derived unflagged expectations mean no shared line changes.
- Put size-dependent refusals in geometry() and repeat them in frame().
- Feed inputs in the operator's own formats. Any implicit conversion runs with -cpuflags 0, because the Linux swscale uses inline MMXEXT.
- Use structured patterns as well as noise.
- Never mirror native reads of uninitialised or out-of-bounds memory; refuse those cases.

Container rules:
- Validate output before creating it.
- Refuse inputs whose native demuxer exports metadata that the chosen output muxer would write (sox comment, extra NIST keys).
- Refuse partial trailing frames and float-to-int paths that are platform dependent.
- Keep codec-id, line-reader and tag tables private to the module.

Merge in ascending `order`. Resolve conflicts in the union-merge files by keeping both sides: sort the audio export lines alphabetically, keep each video array entry on its own line with a trailing comma, and keep the container registration lines (detection must not depend on line order, because every new magic is exact and non-overlapping). A conflict in any other file means the branch broke ownership: reject it and do not hand-merge.
summary:
I chose all 40 slots: 16 audio filters, 14 video filters and 10 media formats (8 demuxers and 2 muxers). 32 are low risk and 8 are medium; the 32 low-risk ones fill orders 1-31 plus sds at 32 (rated medium only because it needs a registry hook). Total is about 64 agent-hours; the scout candidates I dropped and the backfills are listed below. No repository file was edited. My notes and probe scripts are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yukiharada-orca-EdgeFFmpeg/155de616-50a5-4318-8737-c982e4beb7ef/scratchpad/wave-select/ (probe-results.txt plus the sim*.mjs files).

**Verification I ran**
- **Float filters on Linux:** I checked the five double-heavy audio filters that the scouts had not verified on Linux. A plain IEEE-double (unfused) JavaScript transcription matched the Linux x86_64 native build (sha 5e43da9a, run under docker linux/amd64) sample for sample:

| Filter and settings | Linux match | macOS match |
|---|---|---|
| crystalizer, i=-3 and i=2.5 | 10000/10000 | 5991/10000 for i=-3 (i=2.5 not run) |
| compensationdelay, cm=33:mm=7:dry=0.3:wet=0.6 | 10000/10000 | 7404/10000 |
| haas, non-default options | 10000/10000 | 8921/10000 |
| adynamicsmooth, sensitivity=2:basefreq=1000 | 10000/10000 | 8228/10000 |
| aecho, including the 160-sample tail | 10320/10320 | 8931/10320 |

  So these filters can be reproduced exactly on Linux. Their float-sensitive tests must be gated to linux/x64, because macOS fuses the multiply-adds.
- **New candidate wve:** native demuxes a synthesized file as pcm_alaw, 8000 Hz, 512-sample packets, and reads to end of file even when the header duration is shorter than the data.
- **Ownership checks:**
  - **Capability IDs:** all 40 exist in compat/capabilities.json and none is in implementation-progress.json.
  - **Owned files:** none collides with an existing file or another candidate. The video copy filter's files are named video-copy-filter to stay clear of the existing video-copy-ts files.
  - **Native formats:** each video format list is the native list intersected with the 14-entry table. chromashift uses only its yuv list (gbrp belongs to rgbashift).

**Launch blockers that prep/registries must settle**
- **Container registry:** it does not exist yet. All 10 media slots depend on it; without it, every media branch edits the same lines in avformat/src/index.ts and containers/src/detect.ts.
- **Video registry layout:** videoOperators sits on two long lines, and the video registry test's matrix, descriptions and unflagged lists are single lines. Every video branch would conflict there until they are split one entry per line.
- **Shared NOTICE:** each avfilter agent appending to packages/avfilter/NOTICE would collide. I gave every capability its own NOTICE-<NAME> file instead.
- **Sandbox environment:**
  - The environment doc requires Node 24+, but the sandbox has Node 22.
  - `npm test` and `npm run check` need the FLAC Wasm, so agents run targeted tests only.
  - Untimed FLAC input always runs the audio chain, so that path stays unverified until a post-merge run on the macOS host.

**Scout candidates dropped, and why**
- **Audio:**
  - areverse and atrim need edits to the shared descriptor/chain packet vocabulary.
  - aphaser has undefined integer overflow and flanger is high risk.
  - pan duplicates channelmap and routes through swresample.
  - biquad is a 3-hour multiply-add-heavy kernel; it is a backfill.
- **Video:**
  - pad would own the colour module others need, and xstack edits the shared unflagged('linear') line.
  - swaprect, removegrain, edgedetect, colorchannelmixer, lutyuv, hqx and median are medium risk; sobel is high.
  - The low-risk set already filled 14 slots.
- **Media:**
  - The null muxer is blocked by the CLI's absolute-path check and needs a no-file hook.
  - voc's output depends on packet boundaries, which needs a framing hook.
  - y4m needs edits to raw-video.ts and the index.ts dispatch.
  - pcm_vidc and s24daud edit the PcmCodec union and avcodec tables (at most one such agent per wave).
  - dfpwm, adpcm_ima_ssi and adpcm_ima_alp need a non-PCM codec hook.
- **Backfills if a slot frees up or a hook is missing:** pcm_vidc (raw vidc only), the PCM-only subset of the sol demuxer (needs the packet-span hook), biquad, pan, and the integer video filters maskfun, floodfill and rgbashift.
